webpage.text:
Mentor Police seeking suspects who allegedly used counterfeit money at Walmart – News-Herald

Getting your Trinity Audio player ready...

Mentor Police are trying to identify three men who allegedly used counterfeit money at the Walmart on Mentor Avenue on Tuesday. Three males allegedly passed $600 in “high quality counterfeit $100 bills,” according to the Mentor Police Facebook page. The men were seen leaving the store in a black Lexus sedan with an unknown license plate number, said police. Anyone with information can contact the Detective Bureau at 440-974-5760 and reference case number 13-1475. Tips can remain anonymous.
